Convention between Spain and China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and Capital (in force 1992)
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (freedoms of establishment and provision of services)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, Ley de Sociedades de Capital; SEPBLAC and CNMV/notarial UBO registry instructions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Spanish incorporation deed (escritura pública de constitución de Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Notary in the province of the registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarial protocol followed by inscription in the Registro Mercantil Provincial; no Apostille required for domestic registration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy and NIE/TIE proof for each foreign shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority in country of origin and Spanish immigration/police authority (Oficina de Extranjería)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization in country of issuance, followed by certified Spanish sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of legal existence, good standing and incumbency for each corporate shareholder and corporate UBO vehicle
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or corporate registrar of the jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by certified Spanish sworn translation if not issued in Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record / police clearance certificate for each proposed director and UBO, where applicable under Spanish law or for professional licensing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Dirección General de la Policía (Spain) or competent criminal records authority of country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, followed by certified Spanish sworn translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney (poder) granting a Spanish representative authority to sign the incorporation deed where a shareholder acts by proxy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the place where the shareholder or attorney-in-fact executes the power
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization if executed abroad, followed by certified Spanish sworn translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-notarization screening of every shareholder, director, and UBO against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, Spanish restrictive-measures lists, and PEP/reputational databases. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval under Law 10/2010. Adverse hits must be cleared before any notarial act. AML records must be retained for at least ten years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) — electronic denomination-clearing service accessible through the official registrars' portal and notarial telematic systems
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Proposed names must be written in Spanish or transliterated into Latin script. The statutory suffix 'S.L.' or the full phrase 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' is mandatory. Names in foreign languages are accepted where clearly stated in Spanish script and not misleading. Names that suggest regulated or public activities, or that are identical to existing registered names, are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No formal extension is available. If a name certificate expires before incorporation, a new clearance application must be filed. In the event of rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration request before the Registro Mercantil Central within the statutory period, and thereafter an administrative appeal before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública. Counsel should simultaneously prepare alternative names because a rejected name cannot be reserved or renewed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for SL incorporation only where the virtual-office provider maintains a physical address in Spain, is staffed to receive official notifications, and does not cause the Spanish tax-residence test to fail. For an IP patent prosecution agency, a mere virtual mailbox is insufficient to satisfy professional substance requirements and OEPM registration expectations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection during the first 12 months: approximately 15-25% for a low-risk professional-services SL; 35-60% if the registered address is a pure virtual office without verifiable staff or if invoicing patterns create commercial-substance concerns.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Ministry of Justice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official statutory registry tariff; approximately EUR 10-15 per application

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución), including notarial copies and signatures
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish Notary appointed by the notarial district of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff (arancel notarial) scaled to share capital and deed length; market benchmark EUR 500-700

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish sworn translation of foreign passport, UBO, corporate good-standing and police-clearance documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traductor jurado) registered with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional market rate; EUR 60-120 per standard document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille and notarial authentication of foreign personal and corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority in the country of document origin (e.g., Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs or notarial office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory apostille fee plus notarial certification fee as charged by the source jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIE/TIE application and provisional NIF-J (Spanish tax identification code) for the company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Oficina de Extranjería and Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory government fee for the underlying registration; external gestor or counsel fee applies if outsourced

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Inscription of the incorporation deed in the Registro Mercantil Provincial
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered-office province
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory mercantile registry tariff based on share capital and number of registered entries; typical EUR 250-450

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT KYC and UBO compliance pack, including PEP/sanctions screening, notarial UBO declaration and internal compliance brief
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External AML counsel and appointed compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market compliance-service fee; fixed professional fee EUR 300-600

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preincorporation corporate bank or payment-account onboarding and AML due diligence for official patent-office wires and Wise rails
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Selected Spanish bank or licensed electronic-money institution (e.g., Wise)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Financial institution onboarding and AML review fee; market benchmark EUR 250-450

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory-license pre-assessment for patent prosecution and trademark agency activity under Ley 24/2015 and OEPM professional registration requirements
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Oficina Española de Patentes y Marcas (OEPM) and external patent attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Government professional-registration or examination fee plus market legal-advice fee; approximate EUR 150-350

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1/2010, de 2 de marzo, de Sociedades de Responsabilidad Limitada (LSRL), Articles 1-50 on incorporation, governance, and administration
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central and Provincial Registries of Commerce
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital required (minimum_capital_requirement: false); shares must be subscribed and paid up in full
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: First Board Resolution of XYZ SL adopted on [Date] by sole director [Name] unanimously resolves: (1) Subscription of full €3,000 share capital by incorporator [Name] via bank transfer; (2) Adoption of registered office at [Address], Spain; (3) Appointment of [Name] as sole director and [Name] as secretary; (4) Authorization for director to execute incorporation deed, register with Registro Mercantil, obtain NIF, and apply for CAPI patent agency license; (5) Grant of broad powers to director for all formation and operational acts per LSRL. Ensures full compliance with Spanish corporate law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a notary to draft the Estatutos Sociales specifying the company's purpose as PCT Patent Application and International Trademark Registration services. Incorporator provides identification and capital details.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Revise and resubmit if notary identifies any formal discrepancies

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transfer €3,000 subscribed capital to the company's bank account and obtain payment confirmation certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any transfer issues and resubmit

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend the deed if queried by notary

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized deed electronically via the official portal or in person, pay any fees, and obtain the registration certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Provide additional information or appeal if application is queried

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Registro Mercantil certificate to obtain the company's NIF for tax purposes.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any missing documents and resubmit

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Colegio de Agentes de la Propiedad Industrial (CAPI)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de Ejercicio como Agente de la Propiedad Industrial

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharges; standard office waste and emissions compliance with regional environmental regulations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from local fire brigade, structural load inspections if required, and workplace occupational health clearance from labor authorities

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT). Portal: sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, apply for NIF via AEAT using forms 030/036 or the electronic registry. Submit notarized and apostilled incorporation documents, the public deed, initial registration certificate, and power of attorney for a nominee/legal representative. Foreign shareholders require an NIE obtained from consular authorities or AEAT. Provisional NIF is granted immediately; definitive NIF follows verification. For non-resident companies without permanent establishment, obtain a non-resident NIF with a certified fiscal representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. Resident SLs are taxed on worldwide income at a 25% Corporate Income Tax rate. Territorial modifications and special regimes apply to the Canary Islands (IGIC instead of VAT) and Ceuta/Melilla; otherwise no tax-exempt zone status is granted.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not provide a U.S.-style check-the-box election. Elections relevant to SLs include consolidated corporate tax group under articles 58-64 LIS, application of the ETVE (Sociedad Holding Española) regime, creditable R&D & innovation incentives, and opt-in to the EU cross-border loss relief rules. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD are mandatory and non-elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis exemption threshold for established taxable persons. Any habitual supply of goods or services in Spain triggers VAT registration. Non-established non-EU suppliers must register when the first taxable transaction occurs, including distance sales and certain cross-border services, unless the reverse-charge or recipient-accounting rules remove the need for local VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Large taxpayers (turnover exceeding EUR 6,000,000) must submit real-time invoice data to the SII (Suministro Inmediato de Información) via web services/API within specified filing deadlines (e.g., 4 or 8 days). All billing software must comply with the VeriFactu regulation (cautioning that full mandatory enforcement is phased), requiring machine-readable invoice metadata, integrity, traceability, and delivery via qualified software. Public-sector invoices must be sent to the FACe e-invoicing platform. No separate 'digital stamping' is required, but the SII clearance acts as the fiscal control mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of tangible goods outside the EU qualifies for 0% VAT when the goods leave the customs territory and the supplier retains evidencing documentation. Services related to patent prosecution and IP advisory to non-EU business recipients may be zero-rated under the B2B general territoriality rule, provided the place of supply is outside Spain and the recipient is a taxable person in a third country. Conditions include having the recipient's valid VAT/NIF number, confirming business status, and documenting the actual supply to the non-EU jurisdiction.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA/SAD) or AES electronic export record
Bill of Lading / CMR / air waybill evidencing physical exit from EU territory
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank receivables confirmation proving actual receipt of export payment
Commercial invoice, contract, and order documentation
Packing list and insurance certificate (when required)
For services: contract stating recipient business establishment, service description, and recipient's foreign VAT/GST identification, plus evidence of payment and use of services outside Spain
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT and Aduanas conduct posterior verification audits and may demand reinstatement of VAT at 21% plus late-payment interest if the export evidence fails or if the goods/services were diverted into the domestic market without a lawful exit. Fraudulent claims trigger administrative penalties of 50-150% of the VAT at stake, loss of refund entitlements, and potential criminal liability under the Spanish Criminal Code for tax evasion. Retrospective clawback can cover the full statutory limitation period (four to ten years under tax-law exception).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), acting with the European Central Bank for monetary policy, and in coordination with the Secretaría de Estado de Comercio and the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones of the Spanish Ministry for Industry, Trade and Tourism for foreign investment and international trade reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility applies within the eurozone. Spanish law permits unrestricted capital movements and current payments pursuant to Articles 63 to 65 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. There are no exchange-control restrictions on dividend or profit remittances by a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, provided corporate tax obligations and applicable withholding taxes are satisfied. Non-resident ownership of an SL is permitted. Investments from non-EU countries are generally subject to ex-post statistical declarations and, for sectors affecting public order, security, defence, dual-use goods, critical infrastructure and media, may require prior screening or authorisation. All transactions must comply with EU sanctions, anti-money-laundering rules and the Bank of Spain's balance-of-payments reporting regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain does not impose any statutory obligation to surrender, repatriate or convert export proceeds into euros. Exporters may retain foreign currency received in their accounts. Cross-border export receipts are subject to statistical reporting to the Banco de España, typically collected by the receiving Spanish bank through the Declaración de Operaciones con el Exterior framework. There is no mandatory conversion ratio, no surrender period, and no central-bank claim on export proceeds.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High for an EU-licensed EMI with a valid PSD2 passport into Spain; Low for an offshore non-EEA EMI. An EEA-authorized EMI such as Wise can provide multicurrency payment accounts and low-cost remittances, but it cannot act as the exclusive treasury rail for official patent office payments or for holding client trust funds. A non-EEA offshore EMI lacks recognized Spanish banking status and may create AML, sanctions-screening and IBAN-identification friction. The optimal structure is a fully regulated Spanish corporate account serving as the primary rail, with a licensed EU EMI used only for tertiary small-value foreign disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish law does not require directors to appear physically for every corporate account opening. In practice, Spanish tier-1 banks accept video identification and certified electronic identity verification for resident directors, while non-resident directors and UBOs frequently require an in-branch interview or a notarized and apostilled power of attorney. For an SL engaged in IP patent prosecution, the presence of the legal representative may be waived where the board appoints a general counsel or administrator with an NIE and where the bank's digital onboarding protocol permits remote acceptance of apostilled incorporation documents. The KYC file must include the deed of incorporation, articles of association, CIF/NIE of signatories, UBO declaration, proof of registered office, professional licence or IP agency credentials, and source-of-funds documentation for the opening capital deposit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership opacity, especially where non-resident corporate shareholders are interposed through multiple jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A signed UBO declaration, full corporate-organisational chart showing each intermediate entity, notarised and apostilled constitutive documents, passport copies and tax residence certificates of each natural-person UBO, and a statutory board resolution confirming ownership and control structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between the declared business purpose of an SL and expected payment flows, such as IP agency receiving funds from third-party invoicing networks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copies of PCT filing receipts, WIPO and EUIPO payment confirmations, patent prosecution client engagement agreements, itemised professional fee schedules, trademark registration certificates, and a clear list of counterparties and payment reasons aligned with the corporate object.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital contribution or subsequent shareholder loans arriving from third-party payers unrelated to the registered shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements of the contributing shareholder, share subscription or capital increase deed, loan or capital contribution agreement, notarised board approval, evidence of the shareholder's source of wealth and source of funds, and SWIFT MT103 records showing the economic purpose of each transfer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed person status or sanctions-list matching on a director, shareholder or beneficiary.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date PEP and sanctions screening results from a reputable compliance database, a professional legal assessment of the subject, an explicit compliance declaration, supporting identification documents, and a commitment to enhanced transaction monitoring through an external compliance adviser.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of an offshore fintech or EMI as a receiving channel, creating unclear clearing-chain and sanctions-screening risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of the EMI's authorisation in an EEA jurisdiction, its PSD2 passporting notice to the Banco de España, segregation-of-funds certification, an AML compliance letter, and a reassurance that all official patent fee payments are ultimately cleared through a licensed Spanish bank account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections from non-resident shareholders should be transmitted by SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA credit transfer for euro payments within the EEA) from a licensed banking institution to the Spanish SL's operational account. The remittance lines must identify the purpose as an equity contribution or capital increase in respect of ES_SL, referencing the deed of incorporation and the recipient CIF/NIE. The Spanish receiving bank will classify the transaction for Banco de España balance-of-payments purposes using the foreign direct investment category and will require the supporting document package: notarised and apostilled incorporation deed, current bylaws, UBO declaration, shareholder identity documents, NIE of the legal representative, and source-of-funds statements. For non-EU direct investors, where no sectoral screening applies, the transaction is initiated freely and reported ex-post through the bank or, where required, through the corresponding declaration to the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Spanish Patent and Trademark Office, EUIPO and EPO fees in euro are settled through SEPA credit transfers. For non-SEPA official offices, particularly WIPO in Geneva, use SWIFT MT103 wires with complete beneficiary bank, intermediary bank, and payment reference data, including the application or registration number; SWIFT gpi should be used for end-to-end tracking. Commercial letters of credit are a permissible clearing rail where payments must be conditioned on the presentation of documents, but are not standard for official patent prosecution fees. Fintech rails such as Wise may be used for small-value cross-border fee payments only when supported by a fully regulated bank for aggregate treasury settlement. All disbursements must be matched to the underlying patent/trademark reference to satisfy AML and tax documentation requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot transactions for immediate conversion of currency receipts
Outright FX forward contracts for hedging translated fee obligations
Non-deliverable forwards for currencies with restricted convertibility or regional settlement limitations
Cross-currency swaps used in conjunction with underlying commercial or treasury exposure
European-style FX options, primarily purchased options and protective structures, for balance-sheet risk management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts and beneficial ownership declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts must be approved within six months after the financial year-end and filed within one month after approval; for a 31 December year-end, filing is generally due by 30 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may result in fines of approximately EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000, increased for larger companies, and closure of the Commercial Registry record after one year from the filing deadline. Spain has no automatic administrative strike-off solely for late annual accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation of accounting books and corporate minute books
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Electronic legalisation must generally be completed within four months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, the usual deadline is 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted legalisation may impair evidentiary reliability of the books and expose the company and directors to administrative, accounting, and governance compliance risk. Registry charges may apply under the official tariff.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Spanish State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the end of the tax period; for a 31 December year-end, generally 1 to 25 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may trigger fixed or percentage-based penalties, late-payment interest, and surcharges. Unpaid tax may lead to enforced collection proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not applicable as a separate filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Spain does not impose a separate annual return or annual franchise filing for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada. Annual corporate information is principally reported through annual accounts, tax filings, and beneficial ownership declarations.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate annual-return penalty applies. Non-compliance with the applicable accounts, tax, beneficial ownership, or registry obligations remains subject to the relevant statutory sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent Commercial Registry and the Central Registry of Beneficial Ownership, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Beneficial ownership information must be reviewed annually and updated when changes occur; the annual beneficial ownership declaration is generally submitted with the annual accounts.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to identify or update beneficial ownership information may result in registry filing rejection, corporate compliance restrictions, and potential administrative liability under Spanish anti-money laundering legislation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory audit is generally mandatory when the company exceeds at least two of the following thresholds for two consecutive financial years: total assets of EUR 2.85 million, annual net turnover of EUR 5.7 million, or average annual employees of 50. Audits may also be mandatory for regulated entities, securities issuers, certain groups, or where required by law, articles of association, shareholders, or a court.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) and applicable Spanish commercial accounting legislation. IFRS is generally relevant to listed companies and qualifying consolidated groups rather than ordinary private SL entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must identify its ultimate beneficial owners, review the information at least annually, report the beneficial ownership declaration with the annual accounts, and update the Commercial Registry and applicable central beneficial ownership records promptly after any change in ownership or control. Share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the beneficial ownership analysis.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of contracts with the sole shareholder, if applicable

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 325 to USD 1,300 annually, depending on location, mail handling, nominee services, and corporate secretarial scope; Spain does not generally require a separate resident registered agent.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 1,500 to USD 5,000 for a small non-complex SL; fees increase for threshold-based audits, groups, regulated activities, foreign ownership, or significant transaction volume.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 20% reduced rate for qualifying SMEs with annual turnover not exceeding €1 million; additional incentives include R&D tax credits of up to 25% of qualifying expenses

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 100 Corporate Income Tax Return filed electronically via the AEAT portal at www.aeat.es
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 20 days after the end of the tax period (e.g., 20 April for calendar year fiscal year ending 31 December)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of taxable base after all adjustments and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only Spanish-source income; foreign income generally exempt unless permanent establishment
Withholding tax credits applied where applicable
Non-residents may have no quarterly payments required

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalty of €100 per day of delay, capped at €1,500; plus 20% surcharge on the undeclared or underpaid tax plus statutory interest

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Apply for a Treaty Relief Certificate (TRC) from the Spanish Tax Authorities by submitting Form 123 and supporting documentation; the TRC must be provided to the withholding agent prior to payment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 19%, reduced to 0-10% under applicable double tax treaties (e.g., Spain-UK, Spain-US); Interest: statutory 19%, reduced under treaties (often 0% for related party loans meeting arm's length conditions)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (Law 11/2018) require relevant entities to have adequate employees, premises, and core income-generating activities in Spain; failure to demonstrate substance can lead to recharacterization of transactions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting income or claiming false deductions to understate taxable profits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal offense with fines up to 100% of evaded tax and imprisonment from 6 months to 4 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, disqualification from corporate offices, and potential asset seizure

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a company without real economic activity or substance solely for tax avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution, fines up to €1 million, and potential criminal sanctions under anti-avoidance rules
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil leading to personal tax liability, fines, and possible imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in non-arm's length transactions without supporting documentation or using inappropriate methodologies
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties up to €1 million or 5% of annual turnover, plus tax reassessment and interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Joint and several liability for additional taxes due, plus fines and disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Not deducting or remitting WHT on dividends, royalties, or interest paid to non-residents
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €300,000 per infraction plus interest on unpaid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for the withheld amounts, fines, and potential criminal prosecution if willful
